meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: Claude 会接入 GitHub,在 PR 和 issue 的评论线程里参与对话:被别人 @ 时回复,首次被提及后该线程被订阅,后续评论也会回应。
howto.when: 当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论里 @ 机器人账号时触发;使用前需要先建好独立 bot 账号、配好 webhook 和环境变量。

say.text: 帮我添加 GitHub 频道,从 channels 分支复制适配器并注册
say.note: 会复制适配器文件并追加自注册 import

say.text: 把 github:acme/backend 接线到我的 agent group
这个 bot 账号的 token 和 webhook secret 填到哪?
say.note: 会提示写入 .env 的三项配置

howto.what_en: Claude joins GitHub PR and issue comment threads as conversations: it replies when @-mentioned, and after the first mention that thread is subscribed so it answers follow-up comments too.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment. Requires a dedicated bot account, webhook, and environment variables set up first.

say_en.text: Add the GitHub channel; copy the adapter from the channels branch and register it
say_en.note: Copies adapter files and appends the self-registration import

say_en.text: Wire github:acme/backend to my agent group
say_en.note: Creates a messaging group and wires it in per-thread mode

say_en.text: Where do the bot token and webhook secret go?
say_en.note: Points to the three .env values to set
